descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# 🚀 CORE EXPERIENCE
🧠 Enter the Raid.

💣 Loot or die.

🚁 Extract alive.

☠️ Lose everything if you don’t.

# 💬 JOIN THE COMMUNITY

Be part of the development.
Share your raid stories, suggest new features, and help forge the ultimate VR mil-sim.

👉 Discord: https://discord.gg/PD2hnWu4

👉 YouTube :  look for @BadjoEntertainment  showcasing every feature in action

# ⚔️ WHAT MAKES ESCAPE-FROM-X UNIQUE:
1️⃣ No Flowing Menus – Immersion begins here.
[media]
2️⃣ The Raid – Real extraction combat.
[media]
3️⃣ Guns & Attachments – Master your arsenal.
[media]
**NOTE: NPC Melee v0.1 coming up with 0.8.0**
[media]
4️⃣ Hideout – Your sanctuary between chaos.
[media]
5️⃣ Elevator – Step into the mission, no breaks.
[media]
6️⃣ Barter – Trade what you earn, not what you click.
[media]
7️⃣ NPC – Encounters that surprise.
**NOTE: Smarter NPC and Melee coming up with v0.8.0**
[media]
8️⃣ Starting Glock – From nothing to something.

9️⃣ Meds, Food & Drink – Survive the long run.
[media]
🔟 Story – Follow the clues, uncover Patient Zero.
[media]
🏅 Leaderboard – Compete globally.

💀 All About Shooting – Feel the chaos.
